name: Fuecoco
description: Fuecoco, the Fire Croc Pokémon. Able to evolve into Crocalor. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.
